company.name: AllaOna
company.shortDescription: AllaOna is the first car bidding platform in Egypt.
company.description: Alla'Ona is the first auction service for used Cars In Egypt. The company ensures that buying and selling used cars is easy, safe, secure, and hustle-free. It provides a verified checkup service center for each car brand to make sure that the car status is perfectly clarified. It makes sure that the process of transferring the ownership of the cars is smooth by finishing up all the paperwork in offices in each checkup service center. It also provides a pricing reference based on a solid equation for all cars since 2006 model till the latest model, within 2 seconds, so that customers can get used car price range accurately
